title: 48ft, FREE HOUR & Jet Ski Options - Up to 13 Guest
blurb:
Reserve your private Miami yacht rental with Feeling Yachty.

Step aboard a 48ft luxury yacht departing from Rickenbacker Marina and explore Biscayne Bay, Key Biscayne, Miami Marine Stadium, Brickell, Downtown Miami, and nearby areas. Routes vary depending on charter duration and conditions.

This is the exact yacht you’ll enjoy—perfect for birthdays, bachelorettes, anniversaries, and groups of up to 13 guests.

Selected 4-hour options include 1 complimentary hour. A Jet Ski package is also available as a separate booking option, subject to availability, licensing requirements, and daylight restrictions.
